data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 暮色阳台的晾衣回眸
data.description: 微风轻拂的高楼阳台上，白被单在金色晚霞中翻飞。挂好最后一角被单的罗丝薇瑟抬手将吹乱的银发别在耳后，回眸望向端来红茶的你，眼神中流淌着岁月静好的深情。
data.location: breezy apartment balcony with drying laundry against sunset city skyline
data.action: hanging clean white sheets on balcony clothesline, turning back with fluttering silver hair and a radiant gentle loving smile at partner
data.lighting: golden hour sunset light highlighting silver hair and fluttering sheets
data.mood: pure domestic serenity, tranquil golden hour romance, tender companion feeling
data.promptProse: Hanging clean sheets on a sunset balcony, Rossweisse turns back with windblown silver hair, smiling lovingly in golden hour light.
data.animaCaption: Rossweisse looking back gently while hanging laundry on a sunset balcony.
